column1: # merges.tsv -- Vivonne f.102r (L74 box check, ORACLE-LOCATION-1): joined-shape duplicate boxes merged, one box per shape.
# Written 11 Oct 2026 00:54 UTC by the account-3 parent (session_0198Cv8ypBfBVfRToKVWx33M), blind: box geometry and pixels only; no sign
# value, label, transcription, key or reading was opened. db/, settled.tsv and recuts.tsv are the owner's answers and are NOT changed.
# The owner's yes, 11 Oct 2026 about 00:2x UTC, verbatim: "Ya, so let say there were two or three symbols connected this way. I'd
# drag the first box over all of them. Then on the next symbol I'd drag its box over them too. So some dupes."
# His rule 1, 10 Oct 2026, verbatim: "If a symbol was connected to other symbols with no lift off of the pen I marked it as a single
# symbol. Feel free to add a check on these to see if it makes sense or perhaps better if separate."
# Groups: the 11 joined shapes listed in README.md, rebuilt from geometry (same 11, none added or dropped): two tiles on one line
# strip join when their final boxes reach IoU >= 0.5, or when a/b/c siblings were both re-cut by the owner and the smaller box lies
# at least half inside the other. Final box = the re-cut quad's bounding box (recuts.tsv new_*) or, if not re-cut, the machine box.
# Three machine pieces with a sibling suffix are NOT members (L06_b028c, L17_b041a, L21_b022c: other shapes); two not-re-cut pieces
# lying inside a re-cut sibling are left as cut (L22_b035c bad cut, L23_b018a kept) -- the owner looked at both.
# keep = the member first in machine reading order (smallest machine-box centre x); absorbed = the other members.
# Box choice, from two independent blind image checks (A, B) of each group's crops (verdict ok | too-wide | unsure):
#   both ok -> the union of the members' boxes (box_from union);
#   both too-wide and naming the same member as the better fit -> that member's box (box_from member:<sid>);
#   anything else -> the largest member box by area (box_from largest) and status second-look:
#   the owner judges it on the whole-page view. No group goes back to separate boxes: his yes covers all 11; only the box differs.
# check_A, check_B: each pass's verdict and the box it said fits better, in short. Where a pass says the members box two
# separate shapes (G01, G06, G09, G11) that is the one-or-several question, which this file does not settle (the separate blind
# pass in sorters/second-look/joined/ and the box-check team's sign-unit decision do).
# x y w h are source line-image (strip) pixels, the same frame as recuts.tsv new_* and signs.tsv x y w h.
# The largest members used: G01 f102r_L03_b031c (= the union; a non-rectangular quad in recuts.tsv, x y w h is its bounding box),
# G06 f102r_L21_b022b (the union is 6 px wider on the left), G09 f102r_L23_b006c (the union is 14 px wider on the left and 7 px
# on the right), G11 f102r_L27_b022b (= the union).
# Applying it: tools/sorter_apply_recuts.py has no merge step yet, so the box-check lane applies this file -- it drops each
# absorbed sid and sets keep's box to x y w h. 541 boxes become 524.
